Thanks for the pull request. The linked issue #{issue} is assigned to other users, so this pull request was closed. Only an assignee can open a pull request for an assigned issue.

Pick another issue from the [unassigned `ready-for-pr` issues](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Aready-for-pr+no%3Aassignee). Anyone can open a pull request for an unassigned issue.
